vcs.name: SVC (Space VC)
vcs.description: Space VC is a venture capital firm investing at pre-seed in frontier tech startups, backing exceptional founding teams on day zero with $750K to $2M checks into US-focused companies. Areas of investment span space tech, defense tech, manufacturing and industrials, AI, semiconductors, software, cybersecurity, and autonomy. Portfolio companies, including True Anomaly, Castelion, and Neros, have raised more than $1B from top VC firms.

vcs.name: SWAN Impact Network
vcs.description: SWAN Impact Network is an angel investor network that unites, educates, and empowers founders and impact investors who believe positive impact and strong financial return are equally vital. The network has invested more than $18M across 50+ companies, which have gone on to raise over $300M after SWAN funding, and 39% of its funded founders come from underserved backgrounds.

vcs.name: TechRanch Austin
vcs.description: Early-stage incubator/community (Venture Start/Forth/Outfitter) plus US market-entry support for international founders.
vcs.address: 8920 Business Park Dr Ste 250, Austin, TX 78759, USA

vcs.name: Texas Venture Partners
vcs.description: Seed-stage VC investing in early-stage defense tech startups and helping them break into the U.S. market.

vcs.name: Trammell Ventures
vcs.description: Trammell Ventures is a boutique venture capital and business incubation firm based in Austin, Texas, founded in 2011. It incubates and invests in startups across information and cyber security, Bitcoin, cryptoasset and blockchain technology, analytics-driven business modeling, and game development. Its venture investment arm, Trammell Venture Partners, closed the first exclusively Bitcoin-native venture fund in 2022 and is currently raising Bitcoin Venture Fund II.
vcs.address: 6514 McNeil Dr Building 2 Suite 100, Austin, TX 78729, USA

vcs.name: True Wealth Ventures
vcs.description: True Wealth Ventures invests in early-stage, women-led companies that are explicitly improving human and environmental health. Founded by two technology industry veterans, the firm raised one of the industry's largest funds focused on female entrepreneurs, based on the thesis that women-led companies deliver higher returns.

vcs.name: Trust Ventures
vcs.description: Trust Ventures is a venture capital firm that solves policy for generational companies, investing in startups whose progress is blocked by government regulation. Its portfolio includes Base Power Company.
vcs.address: 110 San Antonio St, Austin, TX 78701, USA

vcs.name: Tuesday Capital
vcs.description: Seed-stage firm (fka CrunchFund); reportedly moved SF to Austin.

vcs.name: TVP
vcs.description: Trammell Venture Partners (TVP) is an Austin-based venture firm helping Bitcoin founders build iconic brands at the emergence of a new monetary order. Operating as a high-conviction, concentrated investor dedicated to the Bitcoin ecosystem, TVP has funded 39+ entrepreneurs and invested more than $16M, with portfolio companies including Voltage and Unchained.
vcs.fund: Bitcoin Venture Fund II (Fund I closed 2022)

vcs.name: Unbundled Capital
vcs.description: Permanent-capital firm backing 1-2 founder-led vertical B2B software companies a year post-PMF; led Occupier $16M, Jun 2025.

vcs.name: Unknown Ventures
vcs.description: Unknown Ventures is an Austin-based venture studio that provides funding and operational support for pre-seed to Series A startups in emerging spaces. It invests time, expertise, and capital in founders working to bring about joy and innovation through entrepreneurship.
vcs.address: 201 E 5th St. Apt 104, Austin, TX 78701, USA

vcs.name: Unorthodox Ventures
vcs.description: Carey Smith's (Big Ass Fans) early-stage fund for physical-product makers, $1-5M checks; Supira Medical Series E, Mar 2025.
vcs.address: 5811 Trade Center Dr #900, Austin, TX 78744, USA

vcs.name: Vegvisir Capital
vcs.description: Growth-stage PE in capital-efficient B2B software and tech-enabled services; majority stake in Cira Apps, 2025.

vcs.name: Virtue VC
vcs.description: Austin pre-seed/seed VC focused exclusively on early-stage healthcare founders.

vcs.name: Vista Equity Partners
vcs.description: Global investment firm focused on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled companies, founded in 2000 by Robert F. Smith and headquartered in Austin. With $103B in assets under management and more than 90 portfolio companies, Vista invests across the software lifecycle through private equity and credit strategies, positioning itself for the enterprise AI era.

vcs.name: Whole Foods LEAP
vcs.description: Whole Foods' LEAP accelerator (est. 2022) for early CPG food and beverage brands; 12-week program, up to $25K plus shelf placement; 2026 cohort open.

vcs.name: Wild Basin Investments
vcs.description: Austin evergreen (permanent-capital) firm investing in tech at Seed/Series A/B across US and Canada.

vcs.name: WIV Ventures

vcs.name: YETI Capital
vcs.description: Austin operator-led investment collective founded by YETI co-founder Roy Seiders and Dave Schnadig; $1M to $5M equity checks with board or observer seats.
